task:
Explore: show the search scope explicitly and add a bounded search-radius control for anchored Any searches (map review finding A02). apps/web only; no API change.

VERIFIED ON MAIN (0f6dc228): `apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/ranking-state.ts` `selectFinderRequest` builds the anchored Any request with a fixed `filters.distance {min: 0, max: 500}` and `sort_by: 'distance'`; a picked archetype builds a galaxy-wide `/api/archetypes/rankings` request with no anchor coordinates. The results heading (`#results-title` in `ExploreWorkspace.svelte`) says "Near <anchor>" or "Galaxy-wide <archetype> ranking" / "Galaxy-wide opportunities"; nothing says the radius, and there is no radius control (only results-per-page). The body-filters pop-out (`BodyFilters.svelte`, URL parameter `bodies`) and the refresh-safe `near=<id64>` anchor (`search-state.ts`) exist; custom weights are URL-only by owner decision.

WHAT TO DO:
1. Scope line: under the results heading, one line that states the scope exactly: "Within 500 LY of Achenar · sorted by distance" for anchored Any searches; "Galaxy-wide · ranked by <archetype> fit · minimum tier B" for picked archetypes (reuse the existing tier wording); "Galaxy-wide · best colony potential" for Any without an anchor. Also put the radius into the result cards' distance context where a distance is shown. Accessible as part of the results region (`aria-describedby` on the results list).
2. Radius control: a compact "Within" select beside the scope line for anchored Any searches with the bounded options 100, 250, 500 (default), 1,000 and 2,000 LY; the value lives only in a bounded `radius` URL parameter (`search-state.ts` parse/serialise beside `near` and `bodies`; invalid values canonicalise away with the existing notice), never in local storage. Changing it commits one new search (offset reset to 0) through the same navigation path the body filters use (`commitBodyFilters` pattern), and `selectFinderRequest` uses it for `filters.distance.max`. The control is disabled with the existing "work when you search near a system" style explanation when there is no anchor or an archetype is picked, and a paused radius chip is not needed (a plain disabled control is enough).
3. Do not change ranking semantics, the API request shape (still `filters.distance`), the 24-row page size, or the archetype requests.

TESTS (vitest): `search-state` parse/serialise for `radius` (valid, invalid, duplicate, out-of-range → cleared with the notice); `selectFinderRequest` uses the radius; ExploreWorkspace tests for the scope line in all three modes, the select's enabled/disabled states, one search per change with offset reset, URL round-trip on reload; Cypress product-journey: extend the body-filter journey minimally to assert the scope line text and that changing the radius to 1,000 sends `filters.distance.max: 1000` (keep the existing shared helpers; do not add new intercept aliases that match prefix autocomplete requests). Contract pins in `tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py` may need the new text; update and say so in CHANGES.md.

VALIDATION: in apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`; run `python -m pytest tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py tests/test_review_lab_v3.py`. CHANGES.md: one dated 2026-11-02 entry; note the user-visible change needs Product E2E/visual validation before production promotion and is not deployed.
